fact: FAO states the agricultural statistics plan SPARS 2026-2031 is being aligned with South Sudan's Second National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS II), treating NSDS II as an existing national framework; no period or adoption date is given, so the document's published date is used.

The National Bureau of Statistics presents the National Strategy for Development of Statistics (NSDS) 2014-2020, implementation period 2014-2020, estimated budget US$58 million, with an NSS/NSDS Coordination Unit established at the Bureau; the document gives no adoption date, so its published year is used.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): Master Plan for Statistics Development in Southern Sudan 2021-2025.
